message: v10.7.9 fixes Sandbox manual serving capacity. The Sandbox-only infinite training-compute value no longer leaks into the physical serving fleet when Unlimited Datacenter Serving Capacity is turned off. Manual serving now starts from the real lab baseline and adds only actual datacenters, accelerator generation, custom silicon and leased compute. Existing v10.7.8 serving controls and all v10.7.7 systems remain included.
